name: FunnyMoney
audience: Gen Z students learning to budget while enjoying their social lives
archetype: The Everyperson: a playful, supportive companion
promise: Build better money habits without giving up your social life.
headline: Budget smart. Live fun.
summary: Adulting is a new level. You do not have to play solo. Meet a friendlier approach to budgeting, built around small wins and room for the things you love.
design_direction: Full-width pixel sky and clouds, grassy ground, original coral pig and coin; Pixelify Sans headings, Oxanium body, sticky navigation, light blue dominant with dark green/navy and yellow highlights.
